```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidybayes)
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(c14bazAAR)

library(survival)
```

```{r}
dir = here::here()

#Imnport data
df <- read_csv(paste0(dir,"/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) |>
  mutate(Species = factor(Species)) |>
  filter(Species != "Homo sapiens" | is.na(Species))
```

```{r}
df_sub <- df |>
  filter(Site %in% c("Blombos Cave", "Steenbokfontein")) |>
  select(Site, Date, Uncertainty, `Lab ID`) |>
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(Date),
         c14std = as.numeric(Uncertainty)) |>
  as.c14_date_list() |>
  calibrate(choices = "calprobdistr") |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c("calprobdistr"))

df_sub_int <- df_sub |>
  group_by( Site, `Lab ID`) |>
  summarize(upr = quantile(calage, 0.975),
            lwr = quantile(calage, 0.025))


```

```{r}
df_sub_order <- df_sub_int |>
  arrange(lwr) |>
  group_by(Site) |>
  mutate(g = cumsum(c(TRUE, lwr[-1] > head(cummax(upr), -1)))) |>
  group_by(g, Site) |>
  mutate(max_upr = max(upr),
         min_lwr = min(lwr)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Site, max_upr, min_lwr) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(Event = 1,
         Occupation = seq(1,n(),1),
         Duration = max_upr-min_lwr)

```

```{r}
surv_obj <- Surv(time = df_sub_order$Duration,
                 event = df_sub_order$Event)

surv_obj

km <- survfit(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ Site,
  data = df_sub_order
)

summary(km)

plot(
  km,
  col = 1:2,
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Occupation duration (years)",
  ylab = "Probability occupation persists",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  mark.time = TRUE
)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = levels(factor(df_sub_order$Site)),
  col = 1:2,
  lwd = 2
)
```

# Filter by RFZ during Holocene

```{r}
df_rfz <- df |>
  select(Site, Date, Uncertainty, `Lab ID`, RFZ, Biome, `Archaeological Period`,
         `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(Date),
         c14std = as.numeric(Uncertainty)) |>
  filter(c14age < 10000) |>
  as.c14_date_list() |>
  calibrate(choices = "calprobdistr")
  
  
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c("calprobdistr")) |>
  group_by(RFZ, Site, `Lab ID`) |>
  summarize(upr = quantile(calage, 0.975),
            lwr = quantile(calage, 0.025)) |>
  
  
  arrange(lwr) |>
  group_by(RFZ, Site) |>
  mutate(g = cumsum(c(TRUE, lwr[-1] > head(cummax(upr), -1)))) |>
  group_by(g, RFZ, Site) |>
  mutate(max_upr = max(upr),
         min_lwr = min(lwr)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(RFZ, Site, max_upr, min_lwr) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(Event = 1,
         Occupation = seq(1,n(),1),
         Duration = max_upr-min_lwr)
```


```{r}
df_rfz_filt <- df_rfz |>

surv_obj <- Surv(time = df_rfz_filt$Duration,
                 event = df_rfz_filt$Event)

#surv_obj

km <- survfit(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ 1,
  data = df_rfz_filt
)

summary(km)

plot(
  km,
  lwd = 2,

```

```{r}
df_rfz_filt <- df_rfz |>
  filter(Duration < 1000, !is.na(`Archaeological Sub-chronology`))

km <- survfit(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ RFZ + `Archaeological Sub-chronology`,
  data = df_rfz_filt
)


survdiff(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ RFZ * `Archaeological Sub-chronology`,
  data = df_rfz_filt
)
```

```{r}
# fit a cox model
cox <- coxph(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ RFZ * `Archaeological Sub-chronology`,
  data = df_rfz_filt
)

summary(cox)
```

# Covariate Analysis

```{r}
df_cov <- df |>
  select(Site, Date, Uncertainty, `Lab ID`, RFZ, Biome, `Archaeological Period`,
         `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(Date),
         c14std = as.numeric(Uncertainty)) |>
  filter(c14age < 10000) |>
  as.c14_date_list() |>
  calibrate(choices = "calprobdistr")
  
df_hol <- df_cov |>
  tidyr::unnest(cols = c("calprobdistr")) |>
  group_by(RFZ, Site) |>
  mutate(upr = quantile(calage, 0.975),
            lwr = quantile(calage, 0.025)) |>
  select(-c(density, calage)) |>
  distinct() |>
  
  
  arrange(lwr) |>
  group_by(RFZ, Site, `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(g = cumsum(c(TRUE, lwr[-1] > head(cummax(upr), -1)))) |>
  group_by(g, RFZ, Site, `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(max_upr = max(upr),
         min_lwr = min(lwr)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(RFZ, Site, `Archaeological Sub-chronology`, max_upr, min_lwr) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(Event = 1,
         Occupation = seq(1,n(),1),
         Duration = max_upr-min_lwr)
```

```{r}
df_hol_filt <- df_hol |>
  filter(Duration < 2000)


km <- survfit(
  Surv(Duration, Event) ~ 1,
  data = df_hol_filt
)

summary(km)

plot(
  km,
  lwd = 2,
  xlab = "Occupation duration (years)",
  ylab = "Probability occupation persists",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  mark.time = TRUE
)
```

# Bayesian Analysis

```{r}
df_hol_filt <- df_hol |>
  filter(Duration < 2000 & `Archaeological Sub-chronology` != "Robberg") |>
  rename(Tech = `Archaeological Sub-chronology`) |>
  mutate(censored = ifelse(Event == 1, "none", "right"))

fit_weibull_0 <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~ 1,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 123,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_0)
# shape is > 1, so abandonment hazard increases with occupation duration
```

```{r}
fit_weibull_tech <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~ Tech,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 1234,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_tech)
```

```{r}
fit_weibull_env <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~
    Tech +
    RFZ,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 12345,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_weibull_env)
```

## Test models

```{r}
fit_exponential <- brm(
  Duration | cens(censored) ~
    Tech +
    RFZ,
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = exponential(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  seed = 123456,
  cores = parallel::detectCores()
)

summary(fit_exponential)
```

```{r}
loo_compare(
  loo(fit_weibull_env),
   loo(fit_exponential)
)
```

```{r}
with(
    df_hol_filt,
    table(Tech, RFZ)
)

#Low observations may make the model fit poorly
```

```{r}
hypothesis(fit_weibull_tech, 'shape > 1', class = "")
```

```{r}
draws <- as_draws_df(fit_weibull_tech)

industry_effect <- exp(draws$b_TechEarlyIronAge)

mean(industry_effect)
quantile(
  industry_effect,
  c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)
)
```

## Model shape paramter as random

```{r}
fit_shape_tech <- brm(
  bf(Duration | cens(censored) ~ Tech,
     shape ~ Tech),
  data = df_hol_filt,
  family = weibull(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 4000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  seed = 777
)

summary(fit_shape_tech)
```
